news_body: Orbit Biotech (ORBT) shares surged in early trading today following the announcement of a strategic partnership with Genova Pharmaceuticals aimed at accelerating clinical trials for ORBT’s lead oncology candidate, OBT-301. The collaboration will leverage Genova’s proprietary biomarker technology to optimize patient selection and improve trial outcomes, potentially shortening timelines by up to six months. Analysts are revising price targets upward, with Cowen’s Dr. Lisa Han commenting that the partnership “significantly de-risks the development pathway” and “positions ORBT well for potential licensing deals in 2025.” Volume has spiked, with institutional investors reportedly increasing exposure ahead of a planned FDA submission later this year. Market watchers note that this news likely justifies a premium valuation, with ORBT’s shares trading roughly 3% above the previous close. Investors should monitor upcoming data readouts expected in Q3, which could further validate the company’s clinical approach and drive additional upside.
